# Everyday Types

In this chapter, we'll cover some of the most common types of values you'll find in JavaScript code.

## Arrays

To specify the type of an array like `[1, 2, 3]`, you can use the syntax `number[]`; this syntax works for any type.

## Interfaces

An _interface declaration_ is another way to name an object type:

```ts
interface Point {
  x: number;
  y: number;
}
```
